findings.title: The owner decision table is not yet decision-ready
findings.evidence: docs/R10_VALIDATION.md "Owner decision table" (line ~1613, 20 rows). (a) It opens "Each row is one thing you must accept or do before R10 can be ordered", but rows 8-12 close only by first-article, vibration, pull and bench tests, which can only happen after an order (ORDERING 8.3 is "After delivery"); the table does not separate "decide before ordering" from "accepting now, closing after delivery". (b) No row says whether it blocks the order, what the recommended answer is, or where the owner records a dated yes / no (row 20 asks for a "dated acceptance" but there is no column or place for it). (c) Row 2 is one ~190-word cell with unexplained tokens ("Round 18 m01 to m06", "S-8", "OUT-GND approaches", "CONT_MID"). (d) Row 20 asks the owner to accept "the 137 agent decisions through D-R18-11" and "the open Minors under Gate lane", but the only list is the 1,000+ line R10_DECISIONS.md; the JSON ledger stops at 126 and does not index D-R18-01..11 (M3_R10 says so). (e) The table is at line 1611 of a 2296-line file and the file head (lines 1-60) does not link to it.
findings.impact: A person cannot tell which of 20 items gate the order, which they can defer, or what exactly they are signing in row 20. The Accept rows read as risks already taken rather than choices.
findings.concrete_fix: Add a "When" column (before order / at first article / after delivery) and a "Blocks order?" column; move rows 8-12 to a "Accepted now, closed by test" group; add an "Owner answer / date" column; cut row 2 to 3 short sentences and put the residual list under a sub-heading; for row 20 add a half-page table of D-R18-01..11 (ID, one-line effect, board change yes/no) and say the earlier 126 are covered by the existing JSON; link the table from the first paragraph of R10_VALIDATION.md.

findings.title: PC1 / Q122 gate bound is 0.220 V in the docs but 0.218 V in the pin table
findings.evidence: pin_table.tsv row 16 (PC1): "gate <=0.218 V at 3.6 V". docs/M3_R10.md lines 42, 302, 578 and R10_VALIDATION lines 1520, 1816 say 0.220 V. Arithmetic with R122 1 kOhm, R123 2 kOhm (native values) and a 30 kOhm pull-up at 3.6 V: 3.6 x 2 / (30+1+2) = 0.2182 V, so 0.218 V is the derived figure; no tolerance is stated that would give 0.220. (The BAT_FAULT_N bridge figure 0.554 V = 3.6 x 2 / 13 is derived the same way.) The pin table is hash-bound into the binding note, so the two cannot be reconciled by editing one silently.
findings.impact: Two different bounds for one hand-calculated worst case, in the record the firmware engineer reads (pin table) versus the one the owner reads (M3_R10). Margin to the 0.65 V threshold is large either way.
findings.concrete_fix: Pick 0.218 V (or state the tolerance corner that gives 0.220 V) and use it in M3_R10 (3 places), R10_VALIDATION (2) and ORDERING; the pin_table text is already 0.218, so only docs change.

findings.title: "Seven nets" / "four protected barrels ... and RAW_ACT" does not match BARREL_NETS or the board
findings.evidence: AGENTS.md pyro row, docs/M3_R10.md CH1 pyro ("It now covers seven nets (BARREL_NETS): the four protected barrels (PYRO1_IGN, PYRO1_OUT, PYRO1_GATE and RAW_ACT) and ... the ACT_GATE vias, the BAT_ENABLE vias and the J400.2 hole") and R10_VALIDATION section 1 ("covers seven nets"). tools/check_r10.py BARREL_NETS has 11 names (RAW_ACT, PYRO1_IGN, PYRO1_OUT, PYRO1_GATE, ACT_GATE, ACT_DRV, BAT_ENABLE, BAT_SW_RETURN, ACT_EN, ACT_EN_MCU, PYRO1_GATE_N). Native board: plated barrels exist on 6 of those nets (BAT_ENABLE 3 vias, ACT_GATE 2, PYRO1_OUT via + J121.1, PYRO1_GATE 1, PYRO1_IGN J121.2, BAT_SW_RETURN J400.2) = 10 barrels; RAW_ACT has none. The four "original" barrels are J121.1, J121.2, the PYRO1_OUT via and the PYRO1_GATE via.
findings.impact: A reviewer or the owner reading "seven nets, RAW_ACT included" would look for a RAW_ACT barrel that does not exist, and the count does not reproduce from the code or the board.
findings.concrete_fix: Reword to "S-8 holds 10 plated barrels on 6 nets (list), measured 1.050 mm at the ACT_GATE / BAT_ENABLE / J400.2 barrels and 1.103 mm at J121.1", in the three places; or reword to "the 11 net names in BARREL_NETS (6 carry barrels)".

findings.title: Committed record promises a verification that is not recorded as done
findings.evidence: docs/M3_R10.md "Software and CAD checks", gate-hardening bullet: "These are the gate implementer's numbers; the supervisor's own tools/check.sh run on the final tree confirms them before the commit." The text is committed (1e60441) but is in the future tense, no receipt or log is cited, and STATUS.md says only "Verified by the gate implementer's two tools/check.sh runs (exit 0)". My own read-only runs on the committed tree reproduced check_r10 35 / 35 rules OK, route_check 0 failing (22 bump windows, 6 unrecorded leftovers), fit_check OK with wire room 5.00-5.60 mm, and the counts of test_* functions (shell 10, procurement 20, fab_validation 34, fit 33, paste 16, parts 5, route 67, R10 201 incl. 5 NumPy), but I did not run the self-tests or the full gate.

findings.concrete_fix: Replace with a past-tense sentence naming the run (who, when, commit, exit code) and the log path, or delete the sentence and keep STATUS wording; use the same wording in STATUS.md and M3_R10.

findings.title: Sense-level figures are given without saying powered or cold, and the "no bypass" wording hides a 5.1 kOhm path
findings.evidence: docs/M3_R10.md "Retained deviations": a RAW_ACT bridge to PYRO1_CONT_MID "passes at most 1.6 mA (no R134 or e-match bypass) and raises the CONT reading to about 1.38 V against about 0.75 V intact". R10_VALIDATION section 1 gives healthy / open passive CONT as 99.369 / 146.226 mV. The 0.75 V and 1.38 V figures are the powered-bus readings (8.4 V x 1 kOhm / 11.2 kOhm = 0.75 V; 8.4 V / 6.1 kOhm x 1 kOhm = 1.38 V), the 99 mV figure is the cold reading; neither text says which. The 1.6 mA is the current through R173 (5.1 kOhm) from RAW_ACT to OUT (8.4 V / 5.1 kOhm = 1.65 mA), i.e. a 5.1 kOhm bypass of R134, which is not "no bypass".
findings.impact: An owner or firmware engineer comparing the two documents sees 0.75 V and 99 mV for the "intact" CONT reading and cannot reconcile them.
findings.concrete_fix: Write "powered-bus reading" / "cold reading" beside each figure and replace "no R134 or e-match bypass" with "only a 5.1 kOhm path (<= 1.65 mA), far below fire current".
